en.headline: 44-year-old truck driver dies after collapsing at wheel in Tsing Yi
en.dek: Police said the medium goods vehicle driver lost consciousness while travelling towards Tsuen Wan on Thursday evening; the vehicle hit a kerb and he was certified dead at Yan Chai Hospital.
body: Police are investigating a fatal traffic accident in Tsing Yi on Thursday evening in which a 44-year-old man died.

Officers received a report at 7.39 p.m. that a man was found lying unconscious on a medium goods vehicle on Tsing Yi Road. The man, who sustained no superficial injuries, was rushed to Yan Chai Hospital in an unconscious state and was certified dead at 8.45 p.m.

Initial investigation indicated that the man reportedly collapsed while driving the vehicle travelling along Tsing Yi Road towards Tsuen Wan. The medium goods vehicle then lost control and rammed into a kerb. The Special Investigation Team of Traffic, New Territories South is handling the case.
Anyone who witnessed the accident or has information is urged to contact the investigating officers on 3661 1344.

zh.headline: 青衣44歲貨車司機駕駛期間暈倒 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方指事主周四晚駕駛中型貨車沿青衣路往荃灣方向行駛時失去知覺，車輛失控撞壆，送仁濟醫院後證實死亡。
body: 警方正調查周四晚在青衣發生的一宗致命交通意外，一名44歲男子死亡。
警方於晚上7時39分接報，指有男子倒卧在青衣路一輛中型貨車上失去知覺。事主外表沒有明顯傷痕，昏迷送往仁濟醫院，於晚上8時45分證實死亡。
初步調查顯示，事主駕駛該中型貨車沿青衣路往荃灣方向行駛時暈倒，車輛其後失控撞向路緣。案件由新界南交通特別調查隊跟進。
任何人士如曾目擊意外或有資料提供，請致電3661 1344與調查人員聯絡。
